title: rhododendron ciliicalyx subsp. lyi
intro: Rhododendron ciliicalyx subsp. lyi, commonly known as Lyi Rhododendron or Chinese Rhododendron, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the heath family. The plant is known for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Rhododendron ciliicalyx subsp. lyi are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to possess anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antifungal activities. Additionally, the plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and respiratory infections.
